Indian firm selected for major African project

An Indian-owned firm has been selected by Africa's richest man to undertake a $16 billion project. Separately, an Indian billionaire has hired a Chinese firm for a $498 million project in Zambia, which is set to become Africa's largest copper-waste recovery plant.
